h: The Twilight Creations Prepare the Repair Renewed Each Shabbos

p: and to us on it He gave the Torah."
that the Torah was given to Yisrael on Shabbos
is the spirituality and the inner content
כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה בְּשַׁבָּת שֶׁל מַתַּן תּוֹרָה
as it was on the Shabbos of the Giving of the Torah,
when the Luchos were not given in actuality,
and were engraved in the souls of Yisrael,
from the first utterance to the last.
For in the first utterance it says:
and it is not said in the form of a command,
for it corresponds to Kesser Elyon
which is above the grasp of Chochmah,
Only that so was engraved in the souls of Yisrael
for through the revelation of Godliness
the heart becomes hollow and empty
of all kinds of desire and lust
that were created on Erev Shabbos
for this was after the corruption
and the sin of Adam HaRishon:
so that there be a preparation for the repair
and when the holiness of Shabbos arrives,
there will be bestowed from above
the power of the Ten Commandments,
and so everything will be repaired.
And so they are listed in order:
came in the merit of Moshe,
who is the matter of the Written Torah,
which is the bread of heaven,
and it is the aspect of Chochmah,
"The imperfect fruit of the supernal wisdom is Torah."
And the well is the Oral Torah,
which is likened to all the drinks:
there was the taste of all kinds of drinks,
as is written in the Mechilta;
and it is the aspect of Malchus:
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לָהּ
"the mouth — we call it the Oral Torah."
And its root is from the source,
from the dew that drips from Atika Kadisha,
which is above the aspect of Chochmah;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (כְּתוּבּוֹת קיא, ב)
and as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Kesubos 111b):
the dew of Torah revives him";
and that is the dew that drips from Atika;
and as is written in the passage Pesach Eliyahu (Tikkunei Zohar, introduction):
"Kesser Elyon, which is the crown of Malchus,
'He tells the end from the beginning'" (Yeshayahu 46:10);
and it corresponds to the aspect of Kesser.
is the aspect of a strong assurance,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, made a covenant
that all flesh would not again be cut off,
from the days of the Flood
And certainly it is not for nothing;
if strict justice calls for destruction
and the Holy One, blessed be He, does not waive
שֶׁהוּא מַרְאֵה דְּמוּת כְּבוֹד ה׳ (יְחֶזְקֵאל א, כח)
which is "the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Hashem" (Yechezkel 1:28),
And therefore it says in the Tikkunei Zohar:
toward teshuvah shine in the heart.
even after all the corruptions in the world,
and it corresponds to the aspect of Binah
and he will repent and be healed."

p: "And the script, the writing and the Luchos"
is the aspect of "a Torah of kindness":
that the Torah be given in writing.
there was no need for writing,
for the voices and the utterances
would be written and engraved on the heart,
"And on their heart I will write it."
שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה עַל יְדֵי זֶה לֵב הָאֶבֶן
through which the heart became stone,
that the Torah be in writing,
even upon the heart of stone.
with which one engraves on stone,
as Rashi, of blessed memory, explains;
הֲלֹא כֹה דְבָרִי כָּאֵשׁ נְאוּם ה׳
"Is not My word like fire, says Hashem,
and like a hammer that shatters rock?"
and it is the aspect of "the glory of Yisrael,"
מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
the attribute of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him;
"And the writing was the writing of God,
and our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
כִּי יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ לֹא מֵת (תַּעֲנִית ה, ב)
and he cleaves to the root of life.
כִּי הִנֵּה נֶאֱמַר בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
for behold, it is said of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him
"and he saw that he could not prevail against him"
because he is the root of life,
"and he touched the hollow of his thigh."
And it is found in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 77:3):
who were destined to come from him";
and its intent is the two thighs of truth,
וְהֵם מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְאֵלִיָּהוּ
and these are Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, and Eliyahu:
although they were the choicest of the prophets,
they did not reach the root of life entirely.
And this is what "the grave of Moshe" alludes to:
because there was still in him
some trace of the serpent's counsel;
"And no man knows his burial place";
שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בָּזֶה הַשָּׂגַת שֵׂכֶל אֱנוֹשִׁי
that there was no grasp by human intellect in this:
the language of death and burial.
וְהוּא כְּעִנְיַן מַאֲמַר חַזַ״ל (מְנָחוֹת כט, ב)
And this is like the saying of Chazal (Menachos 29b)
about the death of Rabbi Akiva:
so it arose in thought before Me";
there is no grasp at all
only in the finest of fine thought
the level of speech in the mouth.
in that Will of Atika Kadisha,
which is "the Head that is not known";
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר (יִתְרוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פט, א)
as is written in the Zohar (Yisro, Zohar II 89a).
וּמְעָרָה שֶׁעָמַד בָּהּ אֵלִיָּהוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
"And the cave in which Eliyahu, of blessed memory, stood":
for behold, it is found in the Gemara (Megillah 19b):
in which Moshe and Eliyahu stood
even the eye of a fine needle,
'For no man can see Me and live.'"
That is, because in them too
some trace of the serpent's counsel,
at the root of life entirely;
who went up in the storm to heaven,
did not remain with the body
And so it was not in their power
to grasp the revelation of the Shechinah
while living, alive in the body,
"For no man can see Me and live."
And as is found in the name of R. Y. Birabbi,
כִּי יְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם וָחָי
that God may speak with man and he live;
and now, why should we die, etc.?
that is, when it became known to them
that their impurity had ceased so much
to speak with them face to face,
for what purpose would death be needed,
if there will be additional revelation

p: דְּהִנֵּה אִיתָא בַּגְּמָרָא (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יד, ב)
for behold, it is found in the Gemara (Bava Basra 14b):
why is the passage of Bilam singled out
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him
And how are the narratives of Balak and Bilam different
from the other narratives in the Torah,
when they were written in the Torah,
and the Torah is called the book
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
for it is called by his name,
as is written in Pri Etz Kodesh.
But in the passage of Bilam,
are in themselves words of Torah,
which were said by Hashem Yisbarach;
and not through being written in the Torah
did they become words of Torah;
and therefore this is not counted
And here, where it says "the mouth of the she-donkey"
for the opening of the she-donkey's mouth
הָיָה עַל יְדֵי הַפֶּה טָמֵא שֶׁל בִּלְעָם
was through the impure mouth of Bilam,
only the act of moving the lips.
that when it was the will of Hashem Yisbarach,
He opened the mouth of the she-donkey,
like Bilam in his three blessings.
"that you have struck me these three times (regalim)"
the nation that celebrates three pilgrimage festivals."
the matter of the three blessings
with which Yisrael were blessed by Hashem Yisbarach
as we said in Parshas Balak,
that is found preciously in Yisrael,
the holiness of the three pilgrimage festivals.
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן גּוּף הַקְּלִיפָּה שֶׁל בִּלְעָם
was also the body of the kelipah of Bilam,
and "a man's wife is like his body."
the preciousness of the holiness of Yisrael
and therefore they are not included
in the book of the Torah of Moshe.
from the mouth of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
as is found in Midrash Rabbah, Parshas Devarim.
to the holiness of the aspect of Yesod;
"for from the womb, for Your Name, they are circumcised";
and through this they are called
and they will remain in the root of holiness.
with the nature of all the nations of the world:
that even the most pious of their pious,
and even if he guarded the covenant
as is known from the story
שֶׁל הַבַּעַל שֵׁם טוֹב עִם הַכּוֹמֶר
of the Baal Shem Tov with the priest.
the revelation of the Kingship of Heaven,
only through the power of the holiness of Yisrael.
וְזֶה נִתְבָּרֵר עַל יְדֵי פִּי הָאָרֶץ
And this was made clear through the mouth of the earth
as soon as they reached the mouth of the earth,
the Kingship of Heaven was revealed
"Moshe is true and his Torah is true."
that is, it was revealed to them
that although they were alive and enduring
they went down with their lives
as soon as they reached the mouth of the earth,
with the nature of the nations of the world,
the revelation of the Kingship of Heaven;
even at the entrance of Gehinnom,
were created on Erev Shabbos at twilight,
so that there be a preparation
for the repair of the sin mentioned above.
And when the holiness of Shabbos itself shines forth,
through the holiness of the Ten Commandments;
that the Torah was given to Yisrael on Shabbos,
